interpretation: Literal reviewed design tables, not executable fault fixtures or generated passing traces. All numerical times/ages below are arbitrary toy protocol inputs, not vehicle limits, response guarantees or adopted Perception thresholds.

initial_profile.held_unknown_reason: No endpoint or physical application observed in S1-A.

catalog.identity: All source-manifest digests in these logical examples are 64 ASCII zero characters, explicitly synthetic identities, never the Performance manifest.
catalog.clock_stamp_template: clock_id=TOY_CLOCK, clock_session_id=CLOCK_A, source_tick=t, mapping_id=EXACT_TOY, control_tick_bounds=[t,t], unknown_reason=null.
catalog.E0: Estimate E0: state_si=[2,0,0,0,0,0], capture/publication/receipt at tick 0, quality VALID, FRAME_A/MAP_A, BOUNDED_SET reference TOY_BOUND with interpretation TOY_ONLY, HEALTH_OK, publication latency [0,0]. No vehicle is propagated.
catalog.fresh_estimate_template: E<t>: same labelled synthetic state/uncertainty as E0, with capture=publication=receipt=t. A variant explicitly overrides only its named fields.
catalog.evidence_template: Evidence aliases ending OK refer to named SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION SATISFIED tokens in current estimate/packet/context, valid [0,1000), unless overridden. Concrete immutable ID is alias@estimate_id@packet_id@context_revision; null references use NONE. New contexts require new IDs, never mutation. assumption_set_ref=TOY_ONLY; domain_ids follow token kind; unsupported terminal/uncertainty/fault interpretation is null plus reason. No RECOVERY/DECELERATION/STOP/CONTINUATION/REST_HOLD/REENTRY or REAUTHORIZATION token exists by default.
catalog.synthetic_endpoint_profile: S1-B only: ENDPOINT_A has installed SESSION_A/epoch1, c1 and p1 delivered before tick20, no prior commit/cancel, and a separately labelled initial simulated input [0,0] with matching toy constraint/health evidence valid through tick1000. This value carries no safe-zero or vehicle-motion meaning.

table_expansion: These are specification tables, not runnable Event JSON. At an implementation gate, materialize them against the exact Event/Configuration/Snapshot schemas and review the expansion before running.
Every case is independent and starts from initial_profile plus initial_overrides. All unlisted mutable collections are empty. Packet frame/map and source digests follow catalog defaults.

A permission listed in initial_overrides means its immutable command and ledger record already exist with matching identities. live_permission_ids includes granted unrevoked leases whose end has not passed, including not-yet-started grants.

Same-tick rows are processed by normative phase order; within phase use listed row order as producer_sequence under producer TOY_INPUT. Event IDs are case_id plus 1-based row index; causal parents are referenced prior row IDs when the row depends on them.
Compound event names in a row denote that listed ordered input batch, not an atomic shortcut. expected is the batch final outcome; transition_path retains all intermediate S0 edges.
A request supplies current labelled evidence only when facts explicitly name it. Missing fields cannot be silently materialized as physically validated evidence.
S1-B rows are future endpoint obligations after its separate gate; S1-A logical decisions never satisfy those application assertions.
No case may borrow a permission, latch clearance or rest token from a preceding case.

oracle_pass_fail.pass: Only at a later authorized execution: every literal expected decision/state/permission/path and independent assertion matches, no invariant violated, required channels present and unknowns retained.
oracle_pass_fail.fail: Any mismatch, unauthorized grant/commit, altered provenance, missing required observation, hidden/censored failure or unsupported physical claim fails the affected case and stops for review.
oracle_pass_fail.current: No timeline, state reducer, fault injection or oracle is executed in this document delivery.
